self_assessment: Added KEVType (CISAKEVType=cisa, VulnCheckKEVType=vulncheck) and the KEV/CISAKEV/VulnCheckKEV/VulnCheckXDB/VulnCheckReportedExploitation structs to models, plus a first-class KEVs field on VulnInfo. Bumped go-kev to v0.3.0 (the pinned version had no VulnCheck model) and rewrote FillWithKEVuln to use driver.GetKEVByCveID/db.Response, mapping both CISA and VulnCheck entries into a unified KEV list via a toModelKEVs helper - CISA entries carry Note and normalize the 1000-01-01 placeholder due date to nil, VulnCheck entries carry XDB records and ReportedExploitation. Added ScanResult.FormatKEVCveSummary returning '%d KEVs' and wired it into the one-line reporter summary; SortForJSONOutput now orders KEVs by Type then VulnerabilityName. Verified: go build ./... clean, gofmt clean, and the full go test ./... suite passes.
